report:
Behavior
- Extended the sole `token-assignment` rule so quoted values close only on an unescaped matching delimiter; escaped quotes stay inside the credential.
- `password="alpha \"beta\" gamma" keep-me` → full assignment redacted, `keep-me` preserved.
- `password="alpha beta` (and single-quote / CR-LF variants) fail closed through the line end; no secret suffix survives and later lines are not swallowed.
- Unquoted assignments and all other credential rules unchanged.
- JSON-escaped `\"...\"` alternatives encode the same law for argv/stdout text without decoding, distinguishing `\\\"` (logical escaped quote) from `\"` (delimiter) so matches cannot span assignments.

Owner
- `src/recorder/scanner.ts` only (plus regenerated `dist/recorder/scanner.js`).
- Regressions in `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts` (focused `scanString` table + category × credential promotion matrix).

Root cause
- Naive quoted alternatives closed on the first raw quote, so embedded `\"` truncated early and leaked tails such as `beta\" gamma"`.
- Unmatched open quotes did not match and left the full assignment intact for promotion.
- Prior JSON-escaped body could treat delimiter `\"` as an escape and over-consume across later assignments.

Findings
- Adopted: escape-aware matched quotes, unmatched line-bounded fail-closed, promotion probes for escaped + unmatched values with full-value/suffix markers (not bare hex-like `alpha`/`beta`, which collide with digests).

Verification
- `npm run build:recorder`
- focused: `quoted|assignment|category × credential` → pass
- `npm run typecheck` → pass
- `npm test` → 323 pass
- Worktree clean after one forward commit; authorized files only.
